## Contribution

Describe the learner problem, changed behavior and complete language pair.

## Evidence

- [ ] Sources and technical version checked; original examples and Q&A.
- [ ] Every option has a rationale; labs declare inputs, expected output and cleanup.
- [ ] Content validation, tests, Svelte check and static release checks pass.
- [ ] Draft/future content excluded from HTML, JSON and JavaScript.
- [ ] Existing MATLAB assets and downloads remain intact.
- [ ] Keyboard, narrow-screen, language switch and browser-console checks recorded.
- [ ] Preview artifact / URL and rollback reference recorded.

## Review and release

State the technical reviewer, date and evidence. Keep independent human reading,
learner outcomes and official exam readiness separate from engineering checks.
